industries.title: One POS. Every kind of shop.
industries.sub: From a corner store to a nationwide chain — Tillix adapts to your business, not the other way around.

features_sec.title: Everything you need to run a modern shop
features_sec.sub: Tillix replaces a stack of tools with one clean platform — POS, inventory, purchasing, customers, staff and analytics.
features_sec.f1_text: Ring up sales in seconds with a keyboard-first POS, thermal receipt printing and instant hold/resume.
features_sec.f2_text: Scan any barcode, generate your own labels, and print price tags for bulk items.
features_sec.f3_text: Real-time stock, low-stock alerts, batch and expiry tracking, damages and wastage — always accurate.
features_sec.f4_text: Customer accounts, khata/ledger, discounts and repeat-buyer rewards that grow your basket size.
features_sec.f5_text: Track suppliers, purchase orders, returns and outstanding payables in one clean workflow.
features_sec.f6_text: Live dashboards for sales, profit, best-sellers, cash flow and shift performance — from any device.
features_sec.f7_text: Owner, manager and cashier roles with granular permissions and full audit logs.
features_sec.f8_text: Cloud-first with resilient offline mode — keep selling when the internet is down.
features_sec.f9_text: Manage one shop or a hundred. Central catalog, pricing, stock transfers and per-branch reports.

global.title: Sell Anywhere with Multi-Currency Support
global.sub: One POS Platform. Multiple Countries. Multiple Currencies. Tillix is a cloud POS and retail management software built for businesses operating across different countries and regions.
global.bill_in: Bill in the currency your customers use
global.adapt: From Pakistan POS to UAE POS software, Saudi Arabia POS and USA POS software — Tillix adapts to your market.

why.title: Automate operations. Increase sales. Sleep better.
why.sub: Retail runs on tiny decisions made a thousand times a day. Tillix removes the friction from every one of them — so you spend time growing, not fixing.
why.b1: Automate day-to-day operations end to end
why.b3: Reduce stock loss with live inventory & alerts
why.b6: Grow from 1 till to 100 without switching tools

how.title: Live in three simple steps
how.s1_text: Sign up in under a minute — no credit card required.
how.s2_text: Import your catalog by CSV or scan barcodes, then invite cashiers with the right permissions.
how.s3_text: Ring up sales, track stock, reward customers and watch profits grow — from any device, anywhere.
